ModMetaData.name: VFE Deserters (HSK/CE Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, legodude17 — HSK/CE patch by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK/CE-patched version of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Deserters, tuned for the Hardcore SK modpack.
Original mod by Oskar Potocki, xrushha, and legodude17. This patch version rebalances the mod's player-facing content to fit HSK's spacer-tier economy and research tree, while preserving the full Deserter gameplay loop (contraband, visibility system, quests, scenarios).
--- HSK-NATIVE CONVERSIONS ---
WEAPONS: - Charge Cycler: now crafts at MechWeaponCraftingWorkTable, Charge_weapons_E research, Crafting 16, 35000 work. Ingredients: Charged_Component, Weapon_Parts, ComponentUltra, FerrosiliconAlloy, USLDBar, Plastic. Thump shot ammo swapped to AmmoSet_40x46mmGrenade (HSK-native, no VFE Empire dep). - Fletchling: crafts at MechWeaponCraftingWorkTable, Charge_weapons_D research, Crafting 14, 27000 work. HSK-tier spacer materials.
BELTS: - Deserter Declassifier: HSK-hardcore recipe. TableElectronics, Charge_weapons_D research, Crafting 13, 20000 work. Electronics, ComponentSpacer, Hexcell, FerrosiliconAlloy, Plastic on StrongMetallic stuff base. - Bomb Pack + Invisibility Engulfer: remain quest-drop-only (not player-craftable in HSK balance). Enemies still use them in scenarios.
MORTAR SHELLS (Shrapnel, AP, Cluster): - TableMachining, Crafting 8, 1500 work each. HSK-native materials (Steel, Mechanism, Weapon_Parts, ComponentIndustrial).
FLAGSHIP CHUNK SALVAGE: - Deconstruct yields upgraded to HSK-thematic: Plasteel x20, ComponentSpacer x3, Steel x30. Matches Imperial flagship spacer-tech salvage.
--- DISABLED PLAYER CONTENT ---
Removed from player architect menu (enemy base generation still uses them): - 3 Deserters turrets (Kontarion, Palintone, Onager) — HSK has rich turret roster - 10 IED traps — HSK has its own complete IED lineup - 3 ammo boxes — paired with disabled turrets, no purpose
Striker Turret kept as-is (quest-only, not buildable by player in vanilla either).
--- KCSG SYMBOL FIXES ---
KCSG missing-symbol patches for this mod's layouts (Aerodrone Stations, Safehavens, Zeus Cannon Complex, Imperial Plots, etc.) are now shipped via HSK Mod Fixes Pack as a catch-all covering every KCSG-using mod on the modlist. No per-mod SymbolDef file needed here — enable Mod Fixes Pack alongside this mod.
--- PRESERVED GAMEPLAY ---
ALL core Deserter mechanics unchanged: Visibility system, Contraband, Intel currency, Deserter cells, Aerodrones, quest scripts, scenarios, factions. Supply/Biosecured crates, Deserter Shuttle, Burnout Intel Scraper, Surveillance Pillars — all preserved.
--- COMPATIBILITY ---
Requires: HSK (skyarkhangel.hsk), Combat Extended (CETeam.CombatExtended), Harmony, VE Framework, Royalty DLC, and VFE Empire (for Imperial content). CE's built-in Deserters patches load automatically via its ModPatches folder.
For HSK users — safe to install on any save. Not compatible with the original "Vanilla Factions Expanded - Deserters" mod; enable this INSTEAD.
